question.prompt: An equilateral triangle has a circumradius of 6. Find its apothem.

solutions.explanation: The central angle is \(120^\circ\), and the apothem is \(R\cdot\cos60^\circ=6\times1/2=3\).
solutions.title: Cosine in a central triangle

solutions.explanation: Let \(ABC\) be the equilateral triangle, \(O\) its circumcenter, and \(M\) the midpoint of \(AB\). In an equilateral triangle, each perpendicular bisector is also an angle bisector. Hence \(OM\perp AB\) and \(\angle OAM=30^\circ\). Thus \(AO=6\) is the hypotenuse of right triangle \(AOM\). The side opposite \(30^\circ\) is half the hypotenuse, so the apothem is \(OM=6/2=3\).
solutions.title: A 30° right triangle
